title: Graphic Designer Executive
description:
This role involves designing and producing visual materials for digital and print channels, including marketing collateral, presentations, social media graphics, infographics, and internal communications. The Graphic Designer Executive will collaborate with marketing, business development, and operations teams to translate complex clinical and supply chain concepts into clear, engaging visual content aligned with the company’s brand. Typical responsibilities include creating and refining layouts, icons, and illustrations; developing and maintaining brand guidelines; preparing production\-ready files; and adapting designs for various platforms and formats. The role also requires managing multiple projects, meeting deadlines, and proactively contributing creative ideas to support campaigns and corporate communications.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with the ability to create visually appealing and professional designs for diverse media.
* Candidates should possess skills in Logo Design and Branding to develop, refine, and maintain consistent visual identity across all company materials.
* Proficiency with industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, or equivalent) and familiarity with digital formats and print production requirements.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to follow brand guidelines, and capability to handle multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to incorporate feedback and work closely with cross\-functional teams.

title: Senior Product Designer  (Secrets Manager)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer. As a Senior Product Designer at Bitwarden, you will help elevate the user experience for a product that millions love. We’re looking for someone who believes that security products can both protect users and be delightful and intuitive. You will collaborate with other product designers and product managers to conduct user research, craft solutions, and shape the overall product experience. Our ideal candidate has high attention to detail, is skilled in interaction design, and thrives in a highly collaborative environment.
   

  

 Candidates should have a well\-curated portfolio showcasing their UI and critical thinking skills. This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast\-growing company and contribute to a premium product experience.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Research, design, and iterate concepts for new and existing product experiences
* Create low\-fidelity wireframes, higher\-fidelity prototypes, as well as production\-ready designs for developer execution
* Design and prototype seamless, user\-centric solutions across the Bitwarden platform (desktop, mobile, web, browser extension)
* Conduct and moderate customer and user feedback sessions
* Collaborate and facilitate critique sessions with Product Managers to a diverse stakeholder audience
* Partner with roles and teams across the company to identify opportunities for continuous user experience improvement and feedback


**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**
* 5\+ years of experience in product design or equivalent experience
* Ability to communicate designs through sketches, wireframes, high fidelity mockups, and prototypes
* Expertise in Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or other design tools (we primarily use Figma)
* Experience in planning and executing comprehensive user research and testing cycles
* Technical design expertise: designing systems and applying systems thinking
* Collaborative and adaptable mindset
* Demonstrated experience in influencing leadership regarding design direction by using data and user feedback to justify decisions
* Openness and authenticity, paired with strong communication skills
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and better internet security
* An online portfolio or examples of work showcasing a variety of artifacts created in developing UX solutions.


**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**
* Startup experience
* Experience designing for security\-focused applications
* Experience designing products for both B2C and B2B customers
* Content strategy or technical product writing skills
* Experience with WCAG guidelines
* Experience with developing and evangelizing design systems
* Cross\-platform design experience


**DESIGN AT BITWARDEN**
 The Product Design team at Bitwarden is dedicated to simplifying the management of sensitive data for users of all skill levels, focusing on creating user\-friendly experiences that promote efficiency and security. We aim to provide clear options and guide users toward best practices. Bitwarden's design team strives to create experiences where everyone can manage their data with confidence, fostering trust through a consistent and transparent approach. With this intention, we aim to enhance user experiences by transforming routine tasks into enjoyable moments, ultimately making every interaction with our products delightful and empowering for our customers.
   

  

**WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS**
 Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:
   

  

* Meeting with our Talent Acquisition team
* Interview with Hiring Manager
* Interview with team members
* References


 Successful candidates will be asked to authorize and complete a background check. We do not discriminate based on having a criminal record, and we encourage candidates to be open with us about anything that may come up on the report so we can discuss in advance and determine the impact on the role and company.
   

  

**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**
* The Bitwarden user community loves staying secure, and the feeling is mutual. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose and bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from friends and family to the world's largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You'll become immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open\-source software.
* Bitwarden remains dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work with a motivated and supportive team of colleagues worldwide.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join the Bitwarden \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development.

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Motion Designer** 
 to own motion and interaction design across the Atlys app and website.
   

  

 You'll work with Product Designers, PMs and Engineers to make Atlys feel intuitive, responsive and premium.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role. You'll own motion from concept to final QA, making Atlys feel like a product designed to move rather than one with animations added afterward.
   

  

**The Job**
* Bring product experiences to life. Turn static Figma designs into full interactions, including transitions, micro\-interactions, gestures, and loading, success and error states.
* Simplify complex flows. Use motion to make visa applications, status changes and payments easier to understand, starting early in each feature.
* Own the Atlys Motion Library. Build reusable patterns, motion principles and haptics guidelines that give Atlys a consistent motion language.
* Partner with Engineering to ship it right. Write specs engineers can build, choose the right format (native, CSS, Lottie or video) and keep animations lightweight.
* Own product storytelling. Lead motion for product videos, launches and landing pages that show Atlys' value quickly.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 3–5 years of motion or interaction design experience in a tech company or similarly fast\-moving digital product environment.
* Have a strong portfolio of product UI motion (not just marketing or brand animation) that shows how motion improves usability and communicates state.
* Are highly proficient in Figma and at least one motion or prototyping tool (After Effects, Rive, ProtoPie, Jitter), have hands\-on experience with Lottie, and understand web and native (iOS/Android) constraints.
* Can build and maintain a motion system, and document it so designers and engineers actually use it.
* Communicate motion decisions clearly, push back when motion can fundamentally improve the UX, and spot opportunities without waiting to be asked.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

You’ll support, coach, and grow a small team of product designers while continuing to contribute to the craft yourself. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineering leads, and cross\-functional partners to shape the overall design direction across the Bitwarden platform.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Facilitate design critiques and review sessions, helping the team produce consistent, high\-quality, and accessible work
* Facilitate user research and testing practices — helping the team plan and execute feedback cycles that inform design decisions with evidence
* Drive cross\-functional alignment by clearly communicating design rationale to a diverse stakeholder audience, including leadership
* Identify and implement process improvements that increase design team effectiveness, quality, and velocity
* Uphold and evolve Bitwarden’s design system and standards across desktop, mobile (iOS \& Android), web, and browser extension


**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**
* 3–5 years of experience in product design, with at least some informal experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating the work of other designers
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong UI craft, systems thinking, and the ability to solve complex UX problems across platforms
* Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with other design and developer tools (e.g., Claude, Loveable, Replit, ChatGPT, V0, Adobe, GitHub)
* Experience planning and facilitating user research, testing sessions, and design critiques
* Ability to communicate design decisions with clarity — through sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and in conversation with stakeholders
* A collaborative and adaptable mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity and prioritizing across competing demands
* Strong verbal and written communication skills paired with openness and authenticity — you give and receive feedback well
* The desire to grow as a manager: you’re energized by helping others do their best work, not just doing it yourself
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source software and better internet security


**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**

* Familiarity with WCAG accessibility guidelines
* Experience designing for security\-focused applications
* Experience designing for both B2C and B2B customers
* Cross\-platform design experience (desktop, mobile, web, browser extension)

 The Product Design team at Bitwarden is dedicated to simplifying the management of sensitive data for users of all skill levels, with a focus on creating user\-friendly experiences that enhance efficiency and security. We aim to provide clear options and guide users toward best practices. Bitwarden’s design team strives to create experiences where everyone can manage their data with confidence, fostering trust through a consistent and transparent approach. With this intention, we aim to enhance user experiences by transforming routine tasks into enjoyable moments, ultimately making every interaction with our products delightful and empowering for our customers.
   

  

**WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS**
* Meeting with our Talent Acquisition Team
* Interview with Hiring Manager
* Interview with team members
* Portfolio review
* References


**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**
* The Bitwarden user community loves staying secure, and the feeling is mutual. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose and bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll become immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open\-source software.
* Bitwarden remains dedicated to building a diverse and talented team.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with your team’s support and join the Bitwarden \#growth\-club to continue your personal and professional development.

title: Product Illustrator & Motion Designer
description:
Creato brings creators, brands and shoppers together in one app, with social content, shopping and brand collaborations all in one place. We're building a platform people can trust without second guesses, and we design with close attention to how people think and feel.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Our visual system, design system and core screens are built. Now we want the app to feel alive.
 



 That means creating a brand character. It also means making even the everyday moments feel warm and clear, like loading, errors, empty screens, sign\-up and verification.
 



 You'll be the person who draws it and makes it move.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




**Mascot** 



* Explore, design and finalise Creato's mascot with the Design Head.
* Build its model sheet (expressions, poses, do's and don'ts) so it looks the same everywhere.



**Illustrations for key moments** 



* Design illustrations for empty, error, loading and success states.
* Create scenes for onboarding, the new login experience and the Get Verified (KYC) journey.
* Keep everything within our design system: colours, type, spacing and tone.



**Motion** 



* Animate the mascot and illustrations for the app, using Rive for interactive work and Lottie for simpler animations.
* Design micro\-interactions such as button feedback, screen transitions and success moments.
* Define our motion guidelines (timing, easing and durations) and add them to the design system.



**Storytelling** 



* Storyboard onboarding as a short story, working with the Design Head and our UX/UI designer.
* Make sure every animation has a clear reason to exist.



**Shipping** 



* Hand off light, fast files that developers can plug straight into the app.
* Work with developers to test animations on real devices and fix what breaks.
* Create reduced\-motion versions for users who need them.



**Later** 



* Extend the character and motion to App Store assets, launches and brand moments.



**What success looks like in your first 90 days** 



* The mascot is final, with a complete model sheet.
* A set of animated empty, error and loading states is live in the app.
* The onboarding story is designed and in development.
* Motion guidelines v1 are part of the design system.



**Must\-haves** 



* 3–5 years in illustration and motion design, with at least some of it inside digital products (apps or web).
* **Strong character design.** 
  Your portfolio shows one character drawn across many expressions and poses.
* **Solid animation basics:** 
  timing, easing, anticipation, squash and stretch.
* **Hands\-on with Rive and/or After Effects \+ Lottie** 
 , with at least one animation shipped in a live product.
* Speed in an illustration tool such as Illustrator or Procreate.
* Comfort in Figma, and happiness working within an existing design system.
* Care for file size and performance, not just how the animation looks in a video.



**How you think** 



* **You bring ideas.** 
  You show several directions, not one, and explain why each could work.
* **Delight never hides the fix.** 
  An error screen can be charming, but it must still tell the user what went wrong and what to do next.
* **You work in systems.** 
  You build reusable rules, not one\-off pieces.
* **You're open and honest.** 
  You take feedback well and push back when you have a reason.
* **You sweat the details.** 
  A few frames of timing matter to you.



**Nice to have** 



* Interactive characters built with Rive state machines.
* Rigging experience (bones, mesh deformation).
* A background in casual mobile games or game UI.
* An understanding of sound and haptics in apps.
* Marketing visuals such as App Store screenshots, social posts and launch assets.



**This role may not be the right fit if…** 



* Most of your work is social media reels, templates or video editing.
* You've never shipped an animation inside a product.
* You prefer keeping one personal style over adapting to a brand.



  





**How to apply** 




 Send us:
 


* **Your portfolio** 
  (Behance, Dribbble or your own site), including at least 
 **one character project** 
  and 
 **one in\-app animation** 
 .
* **Proof of shipping,** 
  such as a link to a live app, or source files (.riv or Lottie JSON) if you can share them.
* **A short note** 
  naming one app whose motion you love, and why.



  





**Our process:** 
  portfolio review → conversation with the Design Head → paid 2–3 day task → final conversation with the founders.
 



 What we offer
 


* The chance to create a brand character from day one and see it live in the product.
* Direct work with the Design Head and founders, with real room to shape how Creato looks and moves.

title: NPD (New Product Development) Lead-Product & Design
description:
**Role: NPD (New Product Development) Lead –** 
 Product \& Design  
 



**Team:** 
 New Product Development 
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Founder 
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon (Hybrid) 
 



  
 



  





**About Nurturing Green** 
  
 



  





 Nurturing Green is India's leading gardening lifestyle brand, making plants and gardening products accessible to millions of customers through Retail, E\-commerce and Quick Commerce. 
 



  





 Featured on
 **Shark Tank India Season 4** 
 , we are present across Amazon, Flipkart, Blink it, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket, Myntra and multiple offline retail formats, with an aggressive vision to become India's most loved gardening brand. 
 



  





 We believe great products are born where design, functionality, and storytelling come together. We're looking for a design\-first creative leader who can shape the next generation of Nurturing Green products and create collections that customers love. 
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 
  
 



  
 


* We are looking for an
 **NPD Lead** 
 who combines strong creative thinking with hands\-on product development, category knowledge and execution capabilities.
* The role will own the product journey from
 **concept to sampling, refinement, costing, packaging, production readiness and launch** 
 , while also driving the visual communication of products across catalogues, e\-commerce and marketing touchpoints.
* Working closely with the Founder, Product/Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales and Marketing teams, the NPD Lead will ensure products are creatively strong, commercially viable and operationally ready for scale.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 



  





**1\. Product Development \& NPD** 
  
 


* Identify new product opportunities through consumer insights, market trends, category gaps and business requirements.
* Translate ideas and trends into commercially relevant product concepts and collections.
* Develop concepts, sketches, mood boards, specifications, prototypes and samples.
* Build cohesive collections across plants, planters, home décor, gifting, lifestyle and related categories.
* Own the NPD process from
 **concept → sourcing → sampling → iteration → costing → final approval → production readiness → launch** 
 .
* Maintain product specifications, BOMs, dimensions, material details and NPD documentation.
* Manage sampling cycles and resolve design, functionality, quality and production issues.



  





**2\. Category, Material \& Manufacturing Knowledge** 
  
 


* Develop strong knowledge of relevant product categories, materials and manufacturing processes.
* Evaluate materials, construction methods, finishes and production techniques based on design, cost and feasibility.
* Work with vendors and manufacturers to identify practical and commercially viable solutions.



  





**3\. Vendor, Sourcing \& Cross\-functional Coordination** 
  
 


* Work closely with Purchase, Merchandising and vendors throughout the development cycle.
* Brief vendors on product concepts, specifications, materials, finishes and packaging requirements.
* Evaluate samples and drive revisions until products meet the required design and quality standards.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Warehouse, Sales,and Operations to ensure smooth product development and launch.
* Proactively manage timelines, dependencies, and development challenges.



  
 



**4\. Packaging Design \& Product Communication** 
  
 


* Lead the design and development of
 **product packaging, labels, inserts, tags, sleeves, boxes and other product communication elements** 
 .
* Ensure packaging balances
 **brand presentation, functionality, product protection, cost and production feasibility** 
 .
* Lead or guide the development of
 **product catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives, Quick Commerce creatives and marketing graphics** 
 for new products and collections.
* Ensure product features, specifications, USPs and visual communication are accurate and consistent across customer\-facing touchpoints.



  
 



  





**5\. Team Management** 
  
 


* Lead and mentor Junior Product Designers and other NPD resources.
* Set clear briefs, timelines, and development expectations.
* Conduct regular product and design reviews.



  





**Core Requirements** 
  
 


* **5–8 years of experience** 
 in Product Design, Product Development, NPD, Category Development, or a similar role within consumer/lifestyle brands.
* Strong experience taking products from concept through sampling and production.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, product development, and collection building.
* Hands\-on experience with vendors, manufacturers, and sampling cycles.
* Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, construction, finishes, and product costing.
* Experience in categories such as home décor, lifestyle, gifting, ceramics, hardgoods, furniture, accessories, handicrafts, gardening products or similar consumer products.
* Good understanding of packaging design and development, including production\-ready artwork, materials,timelines, finishes, and vendor coordination.
* Experience with catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives or marketing graphics is preferred.
* Strong creative and aesthetic sensibility with the ability to translate trends into commercially relevant products.
* Ability to manage multiple NPD projects and timelines independently.
* Graduate/Postgraduate from NID, NIFT, Srishti, Pearl Academy, MIT Institute of Design or equivalent design/product development institutes preferred.
* Candidates from pure fashion/apparel design backgrounds are not preferred unless they have significant hardgoods/lifestyle product development experience.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; Canva and AI\-assisted design workflows are preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 
  
 


* Develop differentiated and commercially relevant product collections.
* Move products efficiently from concept to production and launch.
* Build strong vendors and manufacturing relationships.
* Maintain high standards of product quality, design, and functionality.
* Deliver products within expected cost and timeline parameters.
* Ensure packaging and product communication effectively support the product proposition.
* Enable smooth collaboration across NPD, Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales, Marketing and Operations.
* Strengthen Nurturing Green's product portfolio through a balance of creativity, category knowledge, functionality, manufacturability and commercial viability.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 
  
 


* The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of Creative \+ Product \+ Operations.
* They should be able to identify an opportunity, understand the category, conceptualize a product, develop and sample it, work with vendors, evaluate costing and feasibility, solve production challenges, develop packaging and product communication, and coordinate internal teams through launch.
* They should be equally comfortable discussing design concepts, materials, samples, costing, packaging, specifications, vendor feasibility and launch requirements.

**Junior Designer, Marketing Operations** 




 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 We invent the new to help the world move forward. Combining powerful analytics and deeper insights with bigger ideas and innovative solutions, we free up our clients’ potential, thereby fulfilling our own. Take it seriously. Make it fun. Know it matters.
 



 As a Junior Designer within Marketing Operations, you will help bring AXA XL’s global marketing communications to life. Working with colleagues across markets and business areas, you will create high\-quality, on\-brand content across digital, presentation, event and print channels. Using established guidelines and templates, you will build your technical and creative skills while contributing to visible, business\-critical marketing activity.
 



**What you’ll be DOING** 




 What will your essential responsibilities include?
 


* Create and adapt on\-brand marketing materials, including presentations, social media assets, email graphics, web banners, event collateral, infographics and simple print materials.
* Use approved brand guidelines, templates and design systems to deliver clear, consistent and accessible communications.
* Resize, reformat and localise existing creative assets for different channels, markets and specifications.
* Support the development of presentation decks, applying robust layout, typography and visual hierarchy.
* Prepare production\-ready files and complete quality checks for accuracy, consistency, resolution and format.
* Manage assigned design requests through established workflows, keeping stakeholders updated and meeting agreed deadlines.
* Collaborate with marketing colleagues and incorporate feedback constructively, escalating questions where needed.
* Contribute creative ideas and design solutions within established brand guidelines.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of templates and reusable design assets.



 You will report to Senior Manager, Operations C\&M.
 



**What you will BRING** 




 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
 



**Required Skills and Abilities:** 



* Early\-career design experience gained through employment, internships, freelance work or relevant academic projects. A portfolio demonstrating robust design fundamentals is essential.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop; familiarity with Canva or similar tools is beneficial.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and an ability to create polished, well\-structured presentations.
* A sound understanding of layout, typography, colour, imagery and visual hierarchy.
* Robust attention to detail, with the ability to follow brand guidelines and check work carefully.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in asking questions and responding to feedback.
* Organised, collaborative and motivated to learn, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a deadline\-driven environment.



**Desired Skills and Abilities:** 



* Graduate qualification or diploma in graphic design, visual communication, fine arts or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Basic knowledge of digital accessibility, print production, simple motion graphics or video editing is an advantage.
* Experience working within a marketing team, creative studio or shared\-services environment is beneficial.
* Flexibility to collaborate with colleagues across global time zones when required.



**Who WE are** 




 AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
 



  





 How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
 



  





 With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
 



  





 Learn more at axaxl.com
 



  





**What we OFFER** 




**Inclusion** 




 AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
 *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.* 




  




* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ\+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family\-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter



  





 Learn more at axaxl.com/about\-us/inclusion\-and\-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
 



  





**Total Rewards** 




 AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
 



  





 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
 



  





**Sustainability** 




 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023\-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
 



  





 Our Pillars:
 


* **Valuing nature:** 
 How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems \- the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* **Addressing climate change:** 
 The effects of a changing climate are far\-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal\-led solutions.
* **Integrating ESG:** 
 All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* **AXA Hearts in Action** 
 : We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.



  





 For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

description:
**Role:** 
 UX Designer
 



**Function:** 
 Product Design / UX
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, India (In\-office)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company builds medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market.
 



 Its all\-in\-one platform serves thousands of dental practices with analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation. It was founded in 2015 by a practicing dentist, a data strategist, and a PhD technologist.
 



 The team is mission\-driven, execution\-oriented, and moves fast to ship real value.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This is a hands\-on individual contributor role owning end\-to\-end product design — from problem framing and user flows through to high\-fidelity UI and developer handoff. You'll be the design presence in Gurugram, embedded with local PMs and engineers, and reporting to the Senior Designer in the US. The work spans a complex, multi\-tenant platform used by dentists, front\-desk staff, and office managers who need to complete tasks in seconds under real\-time pressure.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Translate product requirements and user problems into flows, information architecture, wireframes, and high\-fidelity UI in Figma — covering web, responsive web, mobile, and kiosk surfaces including empty, loading, error, and permission states
* Prototype interactions to validate and communicate intent before engineering begins; redesign and incrementally improve existing screens as a core part of the workload
* Talk to internal stakeholders (CX, support, sales) and end users to understand workflows before designing them; run lightweight usability tests and use findings to change designs, not justify them
* Use product analytics and support tickets as active inputs to design decisions
* Work within and contribute to the design system — components, patterns, tokens — and produce clear handoff specs covering states, responsive behaviour, edge cases, and interaction details
* Review built implementations against designs and close gaps directly with engineering; apply accessibility fundamentals including contrast, hierarchy, keyboard navigation, and touch targets
* Partner with Product Management from problem statement onward, surface edge cases early, and present design decisions with clear reasoning to distributed US and India teams



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 2\+ years of core UX design experience at an internet or software product company (B2B/B2C SaaS, consumer internet, or product\-led platform)
* Portfolio with 2–3 case studies showing the problem, process, decisions made, and shipped outcome — applications without a portfolio will not be considered
* Strong command of Figma — components, variants, auto layout, prototyping, and shared libraries
* Demonstrated ability to design data\-dense screens: tables, dashboards, filters, and settings
* Experience designing within an existing design system rather than inventing per screen
* Ability to communicate design decisions clearly in written and verbal English to US\-based stakeholders
* Willingness to work in\-office in Gurugram with overlap into US hours (until 9–11 PM IST) as needed



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Formal design education — B.Des / M.Des in Interaction, Communication, or Product Design, or HCI
* B2B SaaS or multi\-tenant product experience; healthcare, fintech, or other regulated\-domain products
* Experience with conversational or voice interface design
* Contributed to building or maintaining a design system
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS sufficient to assess implementation cost; exposure to AI\-assisted design tooling



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end design ownership across a complex, widely\-used platform — web, mobile, and kiosk
* Direct collaboration with US\-based Senior Designer and cross\-functional teams, with high visibility into product decisions
* Fast release cadence (two releases per month) with real, measurable impact on how dental practices operate
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission\-driven, execution\-oriented team

title: Sr. Brand Designer
description:
**About Leena AI**
 Leena AI is the world's largest independent employee\-facing Agentic AI company. Our platform lets employees get answers and get work done across every business system through a single conversation — cutting IT, HR, and finance ticket volume by around 70% at the enterprises that deploy us.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, we serve 500\+ customers across 90\+ countries — including Nestlé, MongoDB, Coca\-Cola, and Etihad Airways — with 200\+ integrations and support for 100\+ languages. We've raised $40M\+ from Greycroft, Bessemer Venture Partners, B Capital, and Y Combinator.
   

  

**The role**
 We're adding a second senior voice to our design team. You'll work alongside our Principal Graphic Designer, who sets the overall standard, and take real ownership of the work that shouldn't have to wait for his review — with the authority to direct it, unblock other designers on it, and hold the quality bar yourself.
   

  

 Roughly 70% of this role is static design and 30% is motion and video. Your primary charter within the static work is digital and paid marketing creative — LinkedIn ads above all, which you'll own outright — plus website design, sales enablement assets, and campaign systems. The motion work runs two ways: minor pieces you build yourself in After Effects and Premiere Pro, and major pieces our motion designers build that you art\-direct and elevate.
   

  

 We also want you to bring an aesthetic we don't already have. If you join and simply match our existing style, we've hired the wrong person. We're looking for a sharply current point of view and someone who will argue for pulling our work forward.
   

  

**What you'll own: Digital and paid marketing creative — your primary charter**
* Own LinkedIn ad creative end to end — static, carousel, document, and video ads, at the volume paid social actually demands.
* Partner with performance marketing on creative testing: hypotheses, variant systems, and reading what the numbers say is working.
* Design landing pages, display, email, and organic social so a campaign holds together from first impression to conversion.
* Bring craft to a discipline that usually doesn't get it. Most B2B paid creative is ugly. Ours shouldn't be.


**Website**
* Design new pages and sections of leena.ai — hero moments, product pages, feature modules, campaign landing pages — thinking in components and breakpoints, not artboards.
* Produce web\-ready assets: product imagery, illustrations, animated GIFs, UI mockups. Hand off cleanly to whoever builds it.


**Brand, sales, and campaign collateral**
* Design the docs that carry our biggest deals: sales narratives, pitch decks, executive presentations.
* Produce high\-craft reports, whitepapers, eBooks, case studies, and one\-pagers for print and digital, plus event and booth collateral.
* Translate abstract product concepts — agents, workflows, integrations — into visuals an enterprise CHRO or CIO understands immediately, without glowing\-brain AI clichés.


**Motion and video**
* Hands\-on: short\-form motion in After Effects — product feature animations, explainers, social cutdowns, UI motion, kinetic type, GIFs. Editing webinars, customer interviews, and event recaps in Premiere Pro, including pacing, captions, color, and audio cleanup.
* Directorial: art\-direct our motion designers upstream of the animation — storyboards, frame design, review — so what they ship looks gorgeous, not merely finished.
* Maintain reusable intros, outros, lower thirds, and title systems so every video looks like it came from the same company.


**Craft, systems, and speed**
* Be the go\-to reviewer when the Principal Designer is heads\-down — clear, useful, unsentimental feedback. Help other designers get to what they were trying to make rather than taking the work off them.
* Build template and component libraries in Figma and After Effects so recurring work gets faster and stays consistent.
* Bring judgment about what deserves a bespoke design, what should be templated, and what shouldn't be made at all.


**How We Work With AI**
 Leena AI is an AI\-first company, and that applies to how we make things, not just what we sell. We use AI research, rethink and re\-strategize, and to compress everything repeatable — resizing and ad variants, background cleanup, rotoscoping, transcription and captioning, first\-pass storyboards, asset versioning — so human hours go into concept, taste, and craft. The parts only a person can do.
   

  

 We expect you to be fluent here and to keep getting more fluent. Designers who use these tools well ship several times more work at a higher standard. Designers who avoid them will struggle here — and so will designers who let AI output ship when it only looks finished. We want both: the speed and the judgment to know when it isn't good enough.
   

  

**What We're Looking For Non\-negotiable**
* Deep, fluent Figma. Not "I can use Figma." Components, variants, auto\-layout, design systems, and libraries other people can build on. This is where the team lives; there's no version of this role where you're slow in it.
* Exceptional, current taste. Well\-composed, well\-typeset, restrained, and unmistakably of this moment. Our highest\-weighted criterion, judged from your portfolio and not your résumé.


**Requirements**
**Must\-haves**
* 4\-6 years of professional design experience, with meaningful time in\-house or at an agency serving B2B or technology clients.
* Real paid\-social and digital ad experience. You've designed ads that ran, at volume, and you understand how creative behaves in a feed.
* Advanced Adobe Creative Suite — Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Working proficiency in After Effects — you can independently take a concept from storyboard to a finished 30\-90 second piece with confident timing and easing.
* Working proficiency in Premiere Pro — 60 minutes of raw webinar footage into a tight, captioned, well\-paced edit without help.
* Web design capability — you've designed responsive pages, not just static comps.
* Presentation design as a genuine skill — you can take a dense, unstructured narrative and make it land visually.
* Active AI fluency — generative and AI\-assisted tools are already part of how you work, and you can tell shippable output from output that merely looks finished.
* The temperament to give and take feedback well. You'll review peers' work without authority over them, which takes more tact than managing does.
* Speed with judgment — several projects at once, a clear sense of a two\-hour job versus a two\-day job, dates hit without negotiating away quality.
* Clear communication in American English — you take written direction well and defend a design decision with a reason, not a preference.


**Nice to have**
* Experience marketing to enterprise HR, IT, finance, or procurement buyers.
* Illustration or 3D chops (Blender, Spline, Rive). Comfort in Webflow or a similar CMS. Sound design instincts for video.


**Not screened for**
 We don't require a specific degree. Design, animation, and fine arts backgrounds are welcome, and so is a self\-taught one. Your portfolio decides this.
   

  

**Your portfolio**
 Required — applications without one won't be reviewed. Send a link (website, PDF, Behance, or Dribbble; include a password if gated). Make it easy for us to say yes by including:
   

  

* Paid social or digital ad work, ideally a set of variants, so we can see how you hold quality across volume.
* One full presentation or long\-form document you designed end to end — not just the cover slide.
* Two motion pieces you animated yourself in After Effects, and one video you edited.
* One piece of web or brand work shown across multiple surfaces.
* A sentence or two per project: what the brief was, what you decided, and why.


**How We'll Evaluate**
**Portfolio screen — we review your work before any call.Craft conversation with the hiring manager — 45 minutes through two or three projects in depth.Design exercise — a real, scoped brief covering both static and motion, roughly a week to complete.Exercise review with the Principal Designer and marketing team — 60 minutes presenting and pressure\-testing your thinking.Leadership conversation and offer.**
 We aim to close in two to three weeks and to give you a clear answer either way.
   

  

**Details**
* Location: Gurugram, India — 5 days in\-office with the marketing and design team.
* Hours: Full\-time, with some overlap with US time zones given our customer and leadership base.
* Compensation: Competitive and benchmarked to senior design talent in the market; we'll discuss range on the first call.


 Leena AI is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants on craft and capability, and we welcome candidates from every background.
   

  

**Benefits**
**What We Offer:**
* Competitive compensation
* Opportunity to work in a fast\-growing, global enterprise Agentic AI platform
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture.

* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production\-grade visual content

 This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver \- someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

title: Videdo Editor cum Graphic Designer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 VIDEO EDITOR \& GRAPHIC DESIGNER
 



 Location: Gurgaon
 



  





 Salary: Up to ₹20,000 per month
 



  





 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





 Work Mode: Work From Home / Hybrid
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a creative and versatile Video Editor \& Graphic Designer who can independently handle both video editing and graphic design requirements for social media and digital marketing. The ideal candidate should have a strong visual sense, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to turn creative briefs into engaging content.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Edit videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, promotional campaigns, advertisements, and other digital content.
 



 • Create engaging short\-form videos with smooth cuts, transitions, text, music, effects, captions, and basic motion graphics.
 



 • Design social media creatives, posts, stories, banners, promotional graphics, and other marketing materials.
 



 • Create thumbnails, campaign creatives, and visual assets while maintaining brand consistency.
 



 • Understand creative briefs and translate ideas into visually appealing videos and designs.
 



 • Handle revisions and optimize content based on feedback.
 



 • Stay updated with current social media, video editing, graphic design, and content trends.
 



 • Manage multiple creative tasks and deliver high\-quality work within deadlines.
 



 • Work independently in a Work From Home / Hybrid setup while coordinating with the team when required.
 



 Required Skills
 



 • Strong proficiency in video editing using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar tools.
 



 • Proficiency in graphic design using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar tools.
 



 • Good understanding of video composition, pacing, transitions, visual storytelling, typography, layouts, and color usage.
 



 • Ability to create engaging and trend\-focused social media content.
 



 • Basic to intermediate knowledge of motion graphics, text animations, sound editing, and visual effects.
 



 • Strong creativity and attention to detail.
 



 • Good communication and time\-management skills.
 



 • Ability to understand briefs, take feedback, and work independently.
 



 Preferred Skills
 



 • Basic understanding of branding and digital marketing.
 



 • Experience with AI\-based creative/video tools.
 



 • Experience creating content for Instagram, YouTube, Meta Ads, or other digital platforms.
 



 • Previous freelance or professional experience in video editing and graphic design.
 



 Eligibility
 



 • Candidates with relevant experience, freelance experience, or a strong portfolio are encouraged to apply.
 



 • Candidates must be comfortable handling both video editing and graphic design responsibilities.
 



 • Portfolio, sample edited videos, and graphic design samples are required.
 



 What We Offer
 



 • Full\-time opportunity to work on video editing, graphic design, and digital content projects.
 



 • Exposure to real\-world social media and marketing campaigns.
 



 • Work From Home / Hybrid flexibility.
 



 • Opportunity for long\-term growth based on performance.
 



 How to Apply
 



 Interested candidates can apply by sharing their Resume \+ Portfolio \+ Video Editing Samples \+ Graphic Design Samples.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
**About The Company**
 Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no\-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences.
   

  

 Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll own complex, foundational initiatives that shape the core of our platform, starting with our customer\-facing control tower, where enterprises design, govern, and monitor their AI agents. Your job is to connect product strategy to coherent, elegant UX: taking ambiguous, technically deep problem spaces and turning them into experiences that feel inevitable.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end design for platform\-foundation initiatives: from framing the problem and shaping strategy through to shipped, polished UX
* Bring coherence to the control tower, unifying agent configuration, governance, and monitoring into one clear mental model for customers
* Drive the design side of our PLG transition: self\-serve onboarding, in\-product education, and experiences that convert without a sales call
* Work directly with real enterprise customers, observing their challenges firsthand and designing solutions that hold up in the world's most complex CX environments
* Establish design patterns, systems, and quality bars that other designers and engineers build on
* Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, and Customer teams across geographies


**Requirement**
* 8–12 years of product design experience, with significant time on complex B2B/enterprise SaaS platforms (AI, data, developer tools, or workflow products a plus)
* Proven ownership of large, ambiguous initiatives from zero to shipped, not just execution against a spec
* High agency: you find the problems worth solving, rally people around them, and drive them to done without waiting for permission
* Unleashed curiosity about customers, AI, systems, and how the business works
* Strong systems thinking: you design coherent frameworks, not one\-off screens
* Excellent collaboration and communication across cross\-functional and distributed teams
* Portfolio demonstrating craft, rigor, and measurable impact on complex products


**Why This Role**
* Consequential scope: your work sets the foundation for the platform's future, not incremental polish
* Real customer problems: direct exposure to Fortune 500 CX challenges and the satisfaction of solving them
* The PLG inflection point: join at the moment design leverage is highest
* Frontier domain: agentic AI is being defined right now; you'll help define what humans need to trust and control it


 Netomi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: AI Graphic Designer
description:
**Role: AI Graphic Designer** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, in person
 



**Team:** 
 Brand \& Creative
 



**Experience:** 
 3–7 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choice. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind:
 



  





 ● Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
 



 ● Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
 



 ● Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We’re looking for an
 **AI graphic des** 
 igner who lives at the intersection of design, social media and generative tools. This is not a ‘take brief, wait for feedback, make rounds’ role. We want someone who will set their own bar, move fast, and use AI \+ design craft to ship distinctive work across categories and platforms.
 



  





**What You’ll own** 



1. Concept to output: Take rough briefs/prompts/business problems and turn them into sharp, on\-brand images \& visual ideas using both GenAI tools and traditional design tools.
2. Multi\-category assets: Design always\-on assets across different categories \& objectives (performance marketing, brand, CRM, app, social,etc.).
3. Platform\-native creativity: Adapt ideas/visuals intelligently for Instagram, YouTube, CRM, OOH, app etc., knowing when to stay strict on brand guidelines and when to bend them to fit the medium.
4. Brand stewardship: Guard the sanctity of brand guidelines, while pushing the edges in a thoughtful, strategic way.
5. GenAI exploration: Use tools like Midjourney, Gemini, ChatGPT, Runway, etc. to generate concepts, imagery across categories and final static \+ short form video assets.
6. Systems \& libraries: Help build and maintain a high\-quality library of prompts, templates and brand assets that make the whole team faster and sharper.
7. Self\-driven projects: Identify visual/creative opportunities teams are not asking for yet and lead them end to end.



  





**Must Haves** 



* Great taste: A sharp eye for typography, layout, colour, visual hierarchy and composition.
* Bar\-raiser mindset. You’re not here to ‘service requests’; you’re here to elevate how the brand looks and feels.
* GenAI fluency: Hands\-on experience and portfolio with Midjourney/Gemini/RunwayML (or similar) as part of your creative process, not just for fun, but for shippable work.
* Strong skills in Figma \+ Adobe Suite (Photoshop / Illustrator / After Effects or similar).
* Ability to interpret business and marketing context: you may not know all the numbers, but you understand what a creative is suppo
 *se* 
 d to do (clicks, recall, trust,etc.).
* A portfolio showing distinctive, well\-crafted work (links required).
* High ownership \& agency: 0 follow\-ups needed to move work forward; you close loops yourself.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience working brand\-side for a D2C or consumer tech brand, not just agency.
* Demonstrable high\-quality work created with GenAI tools (before/after, prompts, process is a plus).
* Comfort working with motion (simple animations, social videos).
* Experience collaborating with performance marketing and brand teams
* Experience streamlining creative workflows with automation/AI for speed



  





**How You Work** 



* You’re comfortable with creative risk: exploring new routes, not just safe, expected ones, while still staying true to the brand.
* You don’t need to be ‘managed’, you manage the work.
* You take a brief, ask sharp questions (if needed).
* You have a strong opinion on what ‘good’ looks like and the craft to back it.



  





**Why Join Urban Company** 




 At UC, you’ll get to work on category\-defining narratives that influence not just our business but the broader culture of work, care, and dignity. You’ll also shape the creative playbook for one of India’s fastest\-growing consumer internet brands, balancing long\-term brand building with near\-term growth.
 



 At Urban Company, we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Digital Product Engineer
description:
**Job Brief**
 Digital Product Engineer
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The Digital Product Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable digital products and web\-based platforms that support Vital Strategies’ public health programs and the Office of Global Innovation’s digital strategy. This is an individual contributor role and will require someone who can bring technical expertise with general understanding of the social sector.
   

  

 Reporting to the MD India and working in close collaboration with the Senior Digital Product Manager and cross\-functional teams (including data science, design, and IT), the role translates data and AI capabilities into user\-centered digital solutions for internal teams, government partners, and the public.
   

  

 This is a role within the AI Innovation Hub, contributing to support multiple entities including India Office’s AI initiatives, the Brazil program portfolio and the Office of Global Innovation’s global digital products.
 **Candidates in the Delhi/NCR region are strongly preferred. Vital’s New Delhi office operates with a full\-time hybrid work schedule. We will also consider qualified candidates outside the Delhi/NCR region for a remote role.**
**Duties And Responsibilities**
**Software Development**
* In collaboration with Senior Digital Product Manager, contribute to Design, Develop, test, and maintain web applications and RESTful APIs using Python.
* Contribute to backend development using FastAPI (or similar frameworks such as Django or Flask) ensuring scalability, performance and security.
* Support the design and implementation of scalable and secure backend services in line with application security best practices.
* Develop and maintain frontend applications using ReactJS (or similar frameworks).
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and data services to ensure seamless functionality.
* Collaborate with data science teams to translate analytical outputs into user\-facing tools.
* Support database design, querying, and optimization using PostgreSQL.
* Contribute to code quality through documentation, version control, and active participation in code reviews.


**Digital Health and Innovation Context**
* Ensure digital products are designed to perform reliably on low\-bandwidth and under\-resourced infrastructure.
* Contribute to documentation accessible to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support user testing, iteration, and deployment of digital solutions in collaboration with product and program teams.
* Contribute to open\-source repositories and shared codebases under the guidance of senior technical staff, adhering to established best practice and governance standards.


**Project Support**
* Support the planning, development, and deployment of digital products within the Innovation Hub.
* Contribute to the preparation of technical documentation, system reports, and knowledge\-sharing materials.
* Provide ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement of APIs and processing pipelines already implemented as digital products.
* Contribute to strengthening institutional knowledge by documenting architecture, technical solutio ns, and lessons learned.


**Qualifications**
**Education and degree**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong proficiency in Python for backend development.
* Experience with backend frameworks (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
* Strong proficiency in RESTful API design.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or relational databases.
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Knowledge of software testing principles, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing concepts.
* Understanding of application security principles (OWASP fundamentals).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).
* Strong customer service orientation
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Time Management \& Organization: Manage multiple tasks and prioritize work to meet project deadlines.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Ability to adjust to shifting project goals.
* Attention to detail actively listens, strong follow\-up, focus on accuracy and thoroughness,


**Preferred**
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker) is a plus.
* Experience with data visualization libraries is a plus.
* Familiarity with open\-source practices is a plus.
* Familiarity with secure development practices (e.g., OWASP fundamentals) is a plus.
* Knowledge of responsive design and accessibility (WCAG).
* Experience with ReactJS or similar frontend frameworks.


**Experience**
**Experience required:**
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience
* Experience in public health, government, or social impact sectors.
* Demonstratable experience building and deploying production\-level web applications.
* Experience working in cross\-functional teams (product, data, design).


**Experience preferred:**
* Experience handling sensitive or health\-related data.
* Knowledge of data protection standards and best practices when handling sensitive or health\-related data.
* Familiarity with digital health standards such as FHIR or DHIS2 etc.
* Experience working in distributed global teams.
* Experience building solutions designed for low\-resource or low\-connectivity environments.


**Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:**
* Ability to travel for work meetings — approximately 20% travel.
* Regular collaboration with distributed team members across multiple time zones
* Occasional international travel may be required for team meetings or project deployments.


**Additional Information**
 As a two\-time Great Place to Work® certified organization, Vital Strategies India is proud to foster a culture rooted in respect, collaboration, integrity, and inclusion. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any basis protected by country or local laws.
   

  

 We are committed to maintaining a professional environment where everyone is treated with dignity and where safeguarding is paramount — we uphold zero tolerance for sexual harassment, exploitation, or abuse, and thoroughly vet all final candidates.
   

  

 The salary range for this position is INR 19,77,500 to INR 30,00,000, complemented by a strong retirement plan, flexible basket reimbursement options, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and paid leave — ensuring our people feel supported, valued, and empowered to thrive both professionally and personally.

title: Product Designer
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. We're 12 people: 2 founders, 3 engineers, 5 in customer success, 1 founding marketer, 1 AE.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 Three engineers, two founders, 600\+ brands running their entire customer conversation on what we've built, and nobody whose job is how it works. That's what we're fixing.
 



  





 You'll build our design system and then make it stick, which is the harder half: the components, the patterns, the rules, and the conversations with engineers about why a rule exists. A system nobody follows is a Figma file, not a system.
 



  





 The rest of the job is design decisions, end to end, and at Spur that means more than screens. When Meta ships something new on WhatsApp, you're the person who reads the documentation, talks to the engineers about what it costs to build, talks to merchants about whether they'd use it, and comes back with what we should build and how it should work. You'll sit with customer success, who hear every complaint, and with the AE, who hears every objection, and neither of them will have to chase you for it.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 




  




* Have built a design system that other people actually used, and can tell us how you got them to use it
* Talk to customers yourself instead of receiving their opinions secondhand
* Read platform and API documentation without being thrown by it
* Have shipped in a small team with no PM layer and no handoff ceremony
* Use AI daily and have built something with it, even a no\-code automation, to kill a repetitive task



  





**Bonus points** 




  




* You've designed for messaging, commerce, or anything with a real\-time inbox in it
* You've worked on a Shopify app, or with Shopify merchants
* You write front end code well enough to prototype, or to argue with an engineer in their own terms
* You know the WhatsApp Business API or Meta's business tools from the inside



  





**Logistics** 




  




* Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office
* You'll be the first designer here, working directly with both founders and all three engineers
* Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit



  





 We read every response ourselves, and you'll hear back either way.
