title: Senior Designer
description:
What’s up?
 **We’re VaynerMedia!** 
 We are a contemporary global creative and media agency with an expertise in driving relevance for clients and delivering impactful business results. The independently\-owned agency was founded in 2009 and has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, Singapore, Australia, Thailand, Japan and Mexico City. VaynerMedia has been recognized for its work at Cannes Lions, the Clio Awards and The Webby Awards. It is part of the VaynerX family of companies.
   

  

**Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it.** 
 VaynerMediaAPAC is strong with a world\-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time \-\-\- PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In APAC, we are proudly \+150, servicing a diverse client all around the region.
   

  

**The PITCH**
 We are creators, creative industry rogues, and SuperBowl stars. We are not just on the internet; we are creating the stuff the internet wants to see. We’re insane for what we do and the people we do it with. We move so fast and make so much good shit that we can’t even keep up with ourselves. So, we need more folks just like us, the unconventional, less\-obvious, unseasoned (
 *or over seasoned* 
 ) creative pros. But above all \- passionate makers and culture shakers.
   

  

 At VaynerMedia, we’re lucky that everyone within our walls thinks creatively – and shares a passion for building communities and understanding a world of micro\-content. In that case, our designers serve a slightly different role than more traditional “digital creative types” but thankfully none of which involve the term “design ninja”
   

  

 You have a passion for design and a hunger to learn how to create pieces that drive engagement and extend brand experiences. However, you also understand that good ideas can come from anywhere and are open\-minded when working with teammates. You are a flexible multi\-tasker who communicates naturally, passionately, and collaboratively. You'll be working exclusively within the digital realm (no print work) and the portfolio you submit should reflect this, but we also love seeing your overall solutions and ideas throughout your book.
   

  

 This exciting opportunity will allow you to work independently while collaborating with our strong force of 50\+ creative team members across APAC.
   

  

**The task at hand:**
* You’ll be asked to do a range of creative work from faster, “smaller” pieces to “bigger” builds for a range of clients, as well as VaynerMedia\-wide projects
* You’ll work within a dynamic team structure with several creative leads, helping to support and deliver on our core community and brand specific campaigns
* You’ll have a mastery of industry best practices and the platforms we love, as well as be willing to learn and articulate the unique VaynerMedia POV on each
* You’ll care about concepting, designing, developing, and putting the team in the best position to present our ideas way more than you do about getting credit for the work
* You’re expected to be as much of a friendly teacher as a proficient doer when working within our Account team structure
* You’ll have strong typography skills, a love and mastery of photoshop and feel very comfortable in all adobe creative suite programs


**The ideal candidate has:**
* A Bachelor’s degree (preferably from a design school) and 3\-5 years of design experience, developing and creating for digital / social strategies \+ campaigns, including client\-facing experience
* The ability to effectively collaborate with various teams, providing the most useful guidance in an enthusiastic and inspiring manner
* A sparkling personality that will mesh well with the existing VaynerMedia family
* A smile on their face the majority of the time
* An understanding of UI/UX, hands on with design (motion and static) and an interest in the big social media platforms and their abilities/limitations (design\-wise).
* Experience working with writers, developers and team focused creative process Mild to major illustration skills
* An obsession with sports, music, or food\-we love people who can bring their own interests into the mix


**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia**
 Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
   

  

 Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start\-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us.
 **We can’t wait to meet you.**
 P.S Portfolio would be nice :)

title: CRO Lead
description:
**OneMetric \| Full\-time \| Gurgaon**
****The role in one line****
 This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the motions around it.
   

  

****Why this role exists****
 Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page — not a doc that someone else has to translate.
   

  

******What You'll Own******
* The website as a whole — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the company's positioning evolves.
* Idea → live page. You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.
* Conversion performance — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the experiments, not just report the numbers.
* Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.
* The lead number. 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.


****What you'll actually do, week to week****
* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a template.
* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales, what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page should be.
* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get from idea to a real, live example fast.
* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.
* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) — so the site shows up in Google and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page as "done" once it ships.


****What we need****
* A CRO brain. You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.
* Strong writing, in service of strategy. You can write clean, persuasive copy, but more importantly you know what needs to be said and why, before you write a word.
* A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design. You don't need to be the designer, but you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief and push back on one.
* The ability to simplify. You can take a genuinely complex service or technical concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer actually understands.
* A working understanding of AEO and SEO. You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search and gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a website role.
* Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency. You write well yourself, and you use AI tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* Comfort with the tools: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude and similar) as part of daily work.
* Ownership instinct — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from other teams.
* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.


****What's in it for you****
* Ownership, not a task list. We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the copy, the page — is yours to run with.
* A performance\-driven culture. Speed and conversion results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get rewarded for it.
* Access to the top of the market. The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not busywork nobody reads.


****How we'll know this is working****
 Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something that's actively working for the business.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

title: Marketing Designer
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
 We are looking for a Marketing Designer to be the design engine behind our marketing. You'll turn briefs and copy into polished, on\-brand assets across the full funnel, landing pages, case studies, social and paid creative, event materials, product collateral, and video, often at speed and across several formats at once. You'll partner closely with content and growth marketing (copy and content sit with the Content Marketing Manager; the visual craft is yours) to keep a consistent visual system across everything we publish, and raise the bar on how the Portcast brand shows up.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* A consistent, high\-quality visual system across everything Portcast publishes, with assets shipped quickly and on\-brand across web, print, social, paid, and video, so marketing can move fast without design becoming a bottleneck or losing craft.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Design landing pages, case study PDFs, product one\-pagers, and sales/product collateral
* Produce social creative (LinkedIn\-first), including post series and campaign templates
* Build paid media and creative for LinkedIn and Google campaigns across personas
* Create event and webinar assets: banners, booth graphics, decks
* Produce and edit video content end to end, short\-form social clips, product feature videos, webinar/event recaps, and launch teasers, from raw footage to polished, on\-brand output
* Maintain and extend the Portcast brand system: components, tokens, templates
* Support HTML email/newsletter production and light web design handoff
* Iterate quickly across multiple design and content review rounds


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent
* At least 3\+ years in a design role, ideally in\-house at a B2B SaaS product\-based startup or at an agency doing B2B marketing, with a portfolio that shows real range across web, print, social, campaign, and video work
* Fast, high\-craft execution: You produce polished work quickly, often across several formats at once, without letting speed erode quality. You take direction and iterate well, but you hold your own opinions on what "good" looks like
* Detail\-obsessed: Pixel alignment, spacing, and consistency matter to you. You catch the small things others miss and hold the visual bar across everything that ships
* Figma (advanced): You work fluently with components, variants, auto\-layout, and shared libraries, and you keep the design system clean and reusable
* Adobe Creative Suite: Strong in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, including multi\-page, print\-ready layouts for case studies and collateral
* Design fundamentals: A strong grasp of typography, layout, grid systems, and brand consistency, and the ability to design for web and print formats interchangeably
* Creative at scale: You're comfortable designing social and paid ad creative at volume from templates, keeping everything on\-brand across personas and campaigns
* Video editing and production: You can take a project from raw footage to finished, high\-quality output, cutting, pacing, color, captions/subtitles, motion titles, and sound. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or equivalent DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut), and CapCut or similar for fast short\-form social edits
* Web and email handoff: A basic understanding of HTML/CSS, enough to work within existing markup for email and web handoff, not necessarily coding from scratch
* Brand systems: Working knowledge of brand systems and design tokens, and how to keep every asset on\-system as the brand scales
* Advanced motion design: animation and motion work (Lottie, complex After Effects, 3D/Blender)
* Presentation design: high\-polish decks in PowerPoint or Google Slides
* AI design tooling: familiarity with image generation, AI\-assisted layout, prompt\-based workflows, and AI video
* Webflow basics: building or maintaining pages in Webflow, not just designing them
* Curiosity for the logistics domain: Experiencein logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is valued, but so is a genuine curiosity to understand our market in depth
* AI\-forward mindset: You consistently apply AI across design workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge
* Startup builder mentality: You thrive in lean, fast\-moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited
* Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross\-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Own the visual craft end to end: You'll own how Portcast looks and feels across everything we publish, with real influence over the brand and few layers between an idea and what ships.
* Build in an industry still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics and supply chain tech is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant room to rethink how enterprise software is marketed and how it looks. You'll bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great design looks like in this space.
* Work at the intersection of AI, design, and logistics: We have a strong product, established enterprise customers, and a real opportunity to sharpen how we show up. You'll get to push AI\-forward design and video workflows, not just execute templates.
* Small by design, fully distributed across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Your work directly shapes launches, customer perception, and how the market sees Portcast.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: We dig into why a design worked or didn't, how a freight forwarder actually operates, and what makes our brand land with customers.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to make, and we stay on a piece until it's genuinely on\-brand and right.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for assets that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for craft, polish, and the experience our brand creates.
* Effectiveness: We focus on design that drives real marketing outcomes, pipeline, launches, and brand perception, not just output. We prioritize the right work and make practical trade\-offs.


 Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through design that is as sharp as the product behind it.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
**Job title field:** 
 Product Designer
 



**Workplace type:** 
 On\-site ·
 



**Job type:** 
 Full\-time ·
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi, Delhi, India
 



**Working Days** 
 : 6 Working Days
 



  





 We are FylFlix, an AI\-native accounting and compliance platform. FylFlix is the product; WFYI Technology Pvt. Ltd. is the company that builds it.
 



  





 We are building India's first agentic accounting harness — the runtime that lets an AI agent actually keep a company's books: read the ledger, write and run its own code in a sandbox, and check every result against the trial balance before it posts.
 



  





**You would be our first design hire.** 
 Not one of a team — the person who decides what design means here, and who grows into leading the function and building the team.
 



  





**WHERE WE ARE, IN NUMBERS** 



* **Already generating revenue** 
 from products and services live in market today.
* **Targeting ₹20 crore ARR inside twelve months** 
 — on our own revenue, from tools and services already launched, before we raise next.
* **Phase one ships December 2026\. Phase two ships March 2027\.** 
 An enterprise\-grade agentic ERP build lands by the end of December.



  





**THE MARKET** 



* Global ERP software is a
 **$106 billion market in 2026** 
 , forecast to reach
 **$281 billion by 2034** 
 . SMEs are already more than half of it — and the fastest\-growing half.
* There are roughly
 **400 million small and medium businesses on earth** 
 — 90% of all companies, 70% of all employment, and half of global GDP. Almost none of them can afford software that genuinely works.
* **Rillet** 
 is building roughly our thesis for the US alone. In August 2026 they raised
 **$100 million at a $1 billion valuation** 
 , two years out of stealth, on
 **$200M\+ total** 
 from ICONIQ, Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia. 600\+ customers, and
 **ARR doubled in three months** 
 . They are going straight at NetSuite.
* The incumbents — NetSuite, SAP, Sage, QuickBooks, Tally — were architected between the 1980s and the 1990s and priced for companies that could afford consultants to install them.
* **We are building this for the world.** 
 India is where we start, not where we stop: 7\.83 crore registered businesses, 1\.67 crore GST filers, and an incumbent turning over roughly $60 million on thirty\-year\-old software.
 **If an agentic ERP works at Indian price points and Indian compliance complexity, it works anywhere.**



**﻿**




**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 



* Every module we have and every one we build next. New products from nothing, and existing ones that need to get better.
* The information architecture and navigation for our accounting suite — decided, defended, and stable.
* A component library our engineers build against without asking you questions.
* Voucher entry an accountant can drive from the keyboard at forty entries an hour without reaching for the mouse.
* The design language for everything that follows — payroll, expenses, reconciliation, the agentic layer.



  





**WHAT WE REQUIRE — please read before applying** 



* **3\+ years** 
 of full\-time product design experience after graduation. Internships and freelance do not count.
* **At least one design of yours is in production right now, used by thousands of people on a recurring basis.** 
 You must be able to name it, link it, and say roughly how many people use it. This is what we screen hardest on.
* **You code your own prototypes** 
 — React or Next.js, running in a browser. With or without AI assistance; we judge the output, not the method. A Figma file is not a prototype.
* Product design, not visual design. Flows, states, edge cases, empty screens, error handling — not brand systems or marketing pages.
* Data\-dense interface experience: dashboards, admin consoles, ERP or POS software, operations tools, complex forms and tables.



  





**STARTUP EXPERIENCE IS A REQUIREMENT, NOT A PREFERENCE** 




 We want people who have built inside a startup — ideally one
 **less than 4–5 years old** 
 when you were there. Being among the first 10–20 employees somewhere is the strongest signal we look for. If your entire career has been at large organisations with briefs handed to you, this will be an uncomfortable fit for both of us.
 



  





**WE ARE NOT FILTERING ON YOUR DEGREE.** 
 Design school, engineering college, or neither. What is in production and who uses it is the entire filter.
 



  





**THE HONEST PART** 



* **Compensation: ₹12–18 LPA fixed.**
* **Working days: six days a week, Monday to Saturday.** 
 We will move to five as soon as we are in a position to, and that is a commitment. But today it is six, and you should decide with that in front of you rather than find it out in month two.
* On\-site in New Delhi. Not remote, not hybrid.
* Relocating? We book and pay for your flight or train.



  





**WHAT YOU GET INSTEAD** 




 No bureaucracy — no approval chains, no committees. Full transparency on revenue, burn and runway; everyone here knows all three. And the chance to be the person who decided what this product looks like.
 



  





**DO NOT APPLY IF** 



* Your portfolio is concept work, unshipped case studies, or redesigns of famous apps.
* Nothing you have designed is currently used by strangers.
* You design in Figma and hand off.
* You are a brand, marketing or graphic designer moving into product.
* You want remote or hybrid, or a six\-day week does not work for you.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
**Overview** 




 As a Principal Product Designer, you will be one of Airtel’s most senior design leaders. You will shape the broadest and most consequential product opportunities often spanning multiple product portfolios, platforms, channels, operating models, or business units.
 



 You will set the organisation’s standard for problem framing, customer insight, interaction and visual craft, systems thinking, technical fluency, storytelling, and measurable design impact. You will guide and approve critical work by senior designers and responsible for their career and growth path. Your contribution will be visible both in the products Airtel ships and in how the wider organisation defines, decides, and builds.
 



  





**What you will own** 



* Long\-range experience direction for major product portfolios or company\-level initiatives.
* The quality and coherence of critical experiences across products, channels, and customer relationships.
* Organisation\-level design frameworks, principles, behavioural patterns, and systemic improvements.
* Executive alignment on complex customer, product, technology, operational, and business trade\-offs.
* Raise the design bar for the most important initiatives and the development of senior design leadership.
* Opportunities for design to create new customer value, differentiation, growth, trust, or operating leverage.



  





**What you will do** 




**Shape company\-level product and experience strategy** 



* Set the gold standard for defining complex customer and business problems with clarity, depth, and strategic relevance.
* Identify opportunities that cut across existing organisational or product boundaries and build compelling cases for action.
* Define or co\-create long\-range experience visions that connect immediate delivery with Airtel’s future product and business direction.
* Balance foundational systems, near\-term outcomes, regulatory or operational realities, and bold future bets.
* Improve the organisation’s approach to customer research, experimentation, measurement, and post\-launch learning where current evidence is insufficient.



**Define the organisation’s design and systems bar** 



* Set and evolve standards for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, content, accessibility, prototyping, service experience, and implementation quality.
* Create principles, frameworks, and reusable behavioural patterns that allow teams to solve complex problems consistently without losing customer context.
* Identify systemic issues across journeys, platforms, channels, terminology, information architecture, and operational processes; lead programmes to resolve them.
* Connect and simplify complex systems while making the consequences of exceptions and trade\-offs explicit.
* Guide the evolution and governance of Airtel’s design system when current components or patterns are insufficient for the next generation of products.
* Shape responsible AI\-enabled products and design practices, including intent definition, behavioural rules, guardrails, feedback loops, explainability, failure recovery, and human oversight.
* Establish or sponsor organisation\-level quality mechanisms that protect the intended experience through build and release.



**Lead the organisation through influence** 



* Influence at every level through exceptional product judgment, evidence, design craft, and business understanding.
* Use prototypes and storytelling to make future opportunities tangible and enable strategic decisions.
* De\-escalate difficult situations, align senior leaders, and move initiatives through complex organisational constraints.
* Direct and critique the work of Lead and Senior Product Designers on the highest\-impact programmes.
* Identify the few decisions or design changes that materially improve an initiative’s customer and business outcome.
* Coach senior designers on strategy, executive influence, systems thinking, prioritisation, technical collaboration, and leadership.
* Build stronger design leaders through clear standards, direct feedback, trust, and visible hands\-on contribution.



**Increase the leverage of Design** 



* Identify where Design can unlock growth, reduce service effort, improve trust, increase adoption, or create new business models.
* Improve design operating mechanisms, cross\-functional collaboration, feedback culture, hiring quality, and senior talent development.
* Represent Airtel Design externally through writing, speaking, industry collaboration, or thought leadership when it creates value.
* Attract and develop exceptional design talent by setting a standard people want to learn from.



  





**What you will bring** 



* Typically 10\+ years of experience in Product Design, with substantial experience shaping complex products, platforms, or ecosystems at scale.
* A body of work demonstrating company\-level problem framing, long\-range vision, systems design, exceptional craft, and measurable business and customer impact.
* Deep expertise across product strategy, interaction design, visual design, information architecture, prototyping, and design systems.
* Strong fluency in research, data, technology, operations, and organisational decision\-making.
* The ability to reason across customer journeys, backend systems, assisted channels, policy, regulation, and service operations.
* A record of influencing executives and aligning multiple teams or business units around a coherent direction.
* A record of creating reusable frameworks or systems that improve outcomes beyond your own projects.
* Evidence of developing senior designers and raising organisational design quality through influence rather than hierarchy.
* Exceptional storytelling, facilitation, negotiation, conflict\-resolution, and written communication skills.



  





**Good to have** 



* Experience in fintech, telecom, banking, payments, identity, AI, marketplaces, platform ecosystems, or other regulated and high\-scale environments.
* Experience shaping products across consumer, enterprise, assisted, retail, and operational channels.
* Industry\-recognised work, public writing, speaking, patents, frameworks, or other external contribution.
* Experience defining new design\-system, AI interaction, or service\-experience conventions.



  





**What success looks like** 



* Airtel makes better portfolio and investment decisions because of your framing and influence.
* Major product areas converge around a coherent customer and experience direction.
* Systemic complexity is reduced rather than redistributed between teams or channels.
* The organisation ships products that are simpler for customers, scalable for technology, viable for the business, and workable for operations.
* Senior designers become stronger strategic and organisational leaders through your coaching.
* Airtel’s design standards, frameworks, and product experiences are recognised internally—and increasingly externally—as benchmarks for quality.
* Design creates measurable new value beyond interface delivery.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Most graphic designers just want to make things look pretty. They obsess over drop shadows and perfectly aligned vectors, but they have absolutely no idea if their design actually generated a click, a lead, or a sale. We don’t hire decorators; we hire growth architects.
 



  





 We are looking for a lethal Graphic Designer who understands the fundamental rules of art and knows how to weaponize them for performance marketing. If you know how to build high\-converting statics, analyze heat maps to improve UI/UX, and actually bring your web designs to life in Framer, we want you on our team.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Work):** 



* **High\-Impact Statics \& Banners:** 
 You will design elite, scroll\-stopping static ads, website banners, and social assets. You understand visual hierarchy, contrast, and typography well enough to direct the user’s eye exactly where we want it to go.
* **The Science of Art:** 
 You don't just rely on Canva templates. You have a deep, fundamental understanding of color theory, composition, and visual weight, and you know how to apply these classical art principles to modern digital marketing.
* **Data\-Driven UI/UX:** 
 You don’t design landing pages based on "gut feeling." You analyze heat maps, scroll\-depth tracking, and click data to identify friction points and redesign interfaces that optimize the conversion rate.
* **Framer Development:** 
 You aren't just designing in Figma and handing it off to a developer to ruin. You have the technical capability to build, animate, and publish blazing\-fast, premium websites directly in Framer.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* You are a rare hybrid who is equally comfortable designing a gritty, direct\-response Meta ad as you are building a sleek, minimalist D2C landing page.
* You check your ego at the door. If a "ugly" high\-contrast banner out\-converts your beautiful, subtle masterpiece, you celebrate the data and adapt.
* You operate with extreme speed and precision. You know how to maintain brand guidelines without letting them slow down your output velocity.



**If you design digital experiences that make people stop, stare, and buy, apply below with your portfolio.**

title: Senior Executive / Deputy Manager – Design
description:
**Company Description** 
 PVR Limited, India’s most admired multiplex chain, was founded in 1995 through a joint venture between Priya Exhibitors Private Limited and Village Roadshow Limited, a global exhibition leader. The company pioneered the multiplex revolution in India by launching the country’s first multiplex cinema in 1997 at Saket, New Delhi. Today, PVR operates over 1,778 screens across more than 355 properties in 113\+ cities, offering expansive reach and diverse audiences. With a strong focus on superior ambiance, advanced technology, and high service standards, PVR delivers distinctive cinema experiences and consistent customer delight. The company is headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurgaon for a Senior Executive / Deputy Manager – Design. The role involves developing and refining visual concepts and design layouts for cinema interiors, signage, branding elements, and promotional materials in line with PVR’s brand identity. The individual will collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as operations, projects, marketing, and vendors to ensure design consistency, cost\-effectiveness, and adherence to timelines. Daily responsibilities include preparing design briefs, reviewing drawings, coordinating with external agencies, and supporting execution on\-site to maintain quality and brand standards. The role also includes monitoring latest design trends and materials to continuously improve customer experience and operational efficiency across multiplex properties.
   

**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated expertise in architectural or interior design, including concept development, space planning, and creation of detailed drawings and layouts.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design and visualization tools (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, Adobe Creative Suite or similar) and comfort working with digital design workflows.
* Strong project coordination skills, with experience managing multiple design assignments, working with vendors, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to translate brand guidelines into cohesive visual and spatial designs that enhance customer experience and support business objectives.
* Attention to detail with a focus on quality, materials, lighting, and finishes appropriate for high\-traffic entertainment environments.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain design concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Relevant professional experience in retail, hospitality, entertainment, or commercial interior design; multiplex or cinema design experience is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture, Interior Design, Design, or a closely related field.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurgaon and visit cinema properties as needed, with flexibility to meet project timelines.

* Work Structure: Five Days Working
* Preferred Background: B.Arch or Architecture or Spatial Design or Communication Design


**About The Role**
 We are hiring a
 **Communication Designer** 
 for a leading design\-led architecture practice.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency** 
 .
   

  

 The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.
   

  

 That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.
   

  

**Why an Architecture Background Helps**
 This is not a typical graphic design role.
   

  

 You will work with:
   

  

  

* plans, sections, drawings, diagrams, renders, photographs, and project notes
* Architectural concepts, material stories, context, process, and spatial intent
* Project decks, award entries, website features, presentations, and design narratives


 To do this well, you need to understand what architects are trying to say before turning it into clear visual communication.
   

  

 A B.Arch background is valuable because the role requires someone who can read design intent, not just arrange text and images.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Create visual communication assets for presentations, website, social media, print, events, and digital platforms
* Support project features, award entries, pitch decks, and design presentations
* Translate architectural ideas into clear visual formats
* Work with principals and design teams to understand project intent
* Develop layouts using strong grid, typography, image treatment, and hierarchy
* Help maintain consistency across the studio’s communication material
* Support communication for talks, school presentations, project launches, and media features
* Work with drawings, renders, site images, process notes, and project stories


**What We Are Looking For**
 You may be a strong fit if you:
   

  

  

* Have a B.Arch or architecture / spatial design background
* Enjoy communication more than conventional architectural practice
* Can understand architectural drawings and design process
* Have strong visual layout and typography sense
* Are comfortable working with both images and text
* Are detail\-oriented and patient with refinement
* Can take feedback from senior design leaders
* Are curious about how architecture is made, presented, and remembered


**Skills Required**
* Visual Communication
* Layout Design
* Typography
* Image Editing
* Presentation Design
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Photoshop
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Microsoft Office


**Good to Have**
* Writing ability
* Architectural journalism interest
* Award entry experience
* Social media content experience
* Videography / editing skills
* Basic motion graphics
* Familiarity with architectural publications or design media

title: User Interface Designer
description:
**About the Role:\-** 




 We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to join our product team and take ownership of designing intuitive, scalable, and user\-friendly experiences across our product. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, and other stakeholders to understand user problems, translate requirements into thoughtful experiences, and take designs from concept to implementation. The ideal candidate is someone who can think beyond visual design — someone who understands user journeys, product workflows, information architecture, usability, and business requirements, while also having a strong eye for UI.
 



  





**What You'll Do:\-** 




 • Work closely with Product Managers to understand product requirements, user problems, and business objectives.
 



 • Translate product requirements and user needs into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
 



 • Design intuitive experiences for complex product workflows while keeping them simple for users. • Create and maintain design systems, reusable components, and UI patterns to ensure consistency across the product.
 



 • Conduct user research, usability analysis, and competitive benchmarking where required.
 



 • Identify UX gaps and proactively suggest improvements to existing product experiences.
 



 • Collaborate closely with engineering throughout the development cycle to ensure design intent is implemented accurately.
 



 • Review implemented features and provide design feedback before release.
 



 • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, product analytics, and stakeholder inputs.
 



 • Maintain design documentation and ensure design decisions are clearly communicated to the team.
 



 • Balance user needs, technical constraints, and business priorities when making design decisions.
 



  





**What We're Looking For:\-** 




 • 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX or Product Design, preferably working on SaaS, B2B, or technology products.
 



 • Strong understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design.
 



 • Experience designing complex workflows and products rather than only marketing websites or landing pages.
 



 • Strong proficiency in Figma and experience working with design systems and reusable components.
 



 • Ability to create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs.
 



 • Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills.
 



 • Good understanding of responsive design and common web application patterns.
 



 • Ability to explain and defend design decisions using user and product context rather than personal preferences.
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced product environment with evolving requirements.
 



 • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 



  





**Good to Have:\-** 




 • Experience designing B2B SaaS / enterprise products.
 



 • Experience working with chatbot, conversational AI, automation, or workflow\-based products.
 



 • Experience with usability testing and user research.
 



 • Familiarity with product analytics and using data to inform design decisions.
 



 • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and frontend development constraints.
 



 • Experience building and maintaining a design system from scratch.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like:\-** 




 • Users can complete key product workflows with minimal friction and confusion.
 



 • New features are designed with consistency and scalability in mind.
 



 • Product experiences become simpler and more intuitive over time.
 



 • Engineering teams have clear, implementation\-ready designs.
 



 • Design decisions are grounded in user needs, product objectives, and data.
 



 • The product maintains a consistent and high\-quality visual and interaction language.

title: Handbag and Accessories Designer
description:
**Brand:** 
 Mexicola
 



**Department:** 
 Design and Product Development
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience Required:** 
 2–3 years
 



**Reports To:** 
 Chief of Design / Creative Director
 


 About Mexicola
 
 Mexicola is a contemporary fashion and lifestyle brand inspired by tropical destinations, artisanal craftsmanship and effortless resort living. Our aesthetic combines vibrant colours, playful prints, handcrafted embellishments and modern bohemian luxury.
 



 We are looking for a creative and technically capable Handbag and Accessories Designer who can translate Mexicola’s distinctive visual identity into original, functional and commercially relevant products.
 


 Role Overview
 
 The Handbag and Accessories Designer will be responsible for designing and developing collections from initial research and concept creation through sampling and production handover.
 



 The role will include designing handbags and fashion accessories such as totes, shoulder bags, crossbody bags, clutches, pouches, wallets, travel accessories, bag charms, keychains and other seasonal products.
 



 The candidate should have a strong understanding of bag construction, materials, trims, hardware, embellishment techniques, functionality and production processes. They must be able to manage each product from concept to final approval while maintaining Mexicola’s quality and design standards.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesTrend Research and Concept Development
 * Research international and Indian trends in handbags, accessories, resort fashion, colour, materials and craftsmanship.
* Study competitor brands, emerging designers, customer preferences and market opportunities.
* Develop seasonal concepts, mood boards, colour palettes, material stories and product directions.
* Translate the Chief of Design’s creative vision into cohesive and commercially viable collections.
* Ensure that every product remains consistent with Mexicola’s tropical, artisanal and luxury\-resort aesthetic.
* Present fresh product ideas, shapes, details and techniques for each collection.


 Handbag and Accessories Design
 * Design original handbags across categories such as totes, shoulder bags, crossbody bags, clutches, bucket bags, pouches, wallets and travel accessories.
* Develop fashion accessories such as bag charms, keychains, straps and other complementary products.
* Create detailed hand sketches, digital illustrations and technical flat drawings.
* Develop product shapes, proportions, compartments, closures, handles, straps and functional features.
* Design surface details such as prints, embroideries, beadwork, appliqué, patchwork, crochet, weaving, quilting and trims.
* Create multiple colourways and material combinations for selected designs.
* Balance creativity, functionality, durability, price positioning and commercial appeal.


 Technical Design and Documentation
 * Prepare complete tech packs containing technical drawings, dimensions, construction details, materials, hardware, trims and finishing instructions.
* Create detailed front, back, side, base and interior views of each product.
* Specify handle drops, strap lengths, pocket placements, closure mechanisms, logo placements and hardware measurements.
* Prepare bill of materials and product\-development sheets.
* Provide clear artwork, Pantone references, embroidery layouts and placement instructions.
* Maintain accurate records of designs, colourways, materials, samples, approvals and revisions.
* Update collection line sheets and product\-development trackers regularly.


 Materials, Trims and Hardware
 * Research and source suitable fabrics, leathers, vegan alternatives, canvas, raffia, jute, woven materials, linings and other materials.
* Develop and select hardware such as buckles, zippers, hooks, rings, chains, magnetic closures, feet and logo plates.
* Source trims, tapes, cords, fringes, tassels and embellishment materials.
* Ensure that selected materials meet the required standards for quality, durability, functionality and cost.
* Coordinate with vendors to develop customised materials, hardware and trims where required.
* Maintain an organised material, trim and hardware library.


 Print, Embroidery and Surface Development
 * Develop original prints, placement artworks and surface\-design concepts for handbags and accessories.
* Create or coordinate embroidery, beadwork, appliqué and other handcrafted embellishment layouts.
* Prepare accurate colour references, motif sizes and placement specifications.
* Review strike\-offs, embroidery swatches, beading samples and material trials.
* Provide clear correction comments and ensure that approved surface details are accurately reproduced.


 Sampling and Product Development
 * Coordinate with pattern makers, sample makers, merchandisers and vendors to develop prototypes and samples.
* Review handbag patterns, proportions, construction, functionality and finishing.
* Evaluate sample size, weight, opening, storage capacity, strap comfort and overall usability.
* Check stitching, lining, reinforcement, edge finishing, closures and hardware quality.
* Compare samples with approved sketches, tech packs, materials and reference images.
* Conduct sample\-review meetings and provide detailed correction comments.
* Follow every style through prototype, revised sample, pre\-production sample and final approval.
* Ensure that all corrections are implemented before production.


 Collection Planning and Coordination
 * Work with the Chief of Design to prepare seasonal range plans and development calendars.
* Plan a balanced assortment across categories, sizes, shapes, materials, colours and price points.
* Coordinate handbag and accessory collections with Mexicola’s apparel collections.
* Manage multiple products and development timelines simultaneously.
* Coordinate with merchandising, sourcing, production, quality and marketing teams.
* Follow up proactively on materials, artworks, samples, costing and approvals.
* Identify and communicate potential delays or quality concerns at an early stage.


 Costing and Commercial Awareness
 * Design products according to the brand’s target price points and customer profile.
* Work with merchandising and production teams to review product costing.
* Suggest suitable materials or construction modifications when required to meet cost targets.
* Make value\-engineering recommendations without compromising the overall design language or perceived quality.
* Understand minimum order quantities, material consumption and production feasibility.
* Use sales feedback and product performance to improve future collections.


 Production and Quality Support
 * Ensure that bulk production follows approved samples and technical specifications.
* Review production samples and flag deviations in construction, colour, materials, hardware or embellishments.
* Work with production and quality teams to resolve design\-related issues.
* Ensure consistency in product dimensions, workmanship, finishing and functionality.
* Maintain Mexicola’s quality standards throughout the production process.


 Shoot and Launch Support
 * Assist with product selection and styling for campaign, catalogue and e\-commerce shoots.
* Prepare product details, styling references and collection notes for the content team.
* Ensure that samples required for shoots, presentations and launches are complete and approved.
* Support the development of lookbooks, line sheets, product presentations and launch materials.

title: Fashion Designer – Apparel
description:
**Brand:** 
 Mexicola
 



**Department:** 
 Design and Product Development
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience Required:** 
 2–3 years
 



**Reports To:** 
 Chief of Design / Creative Director
 


 About Mexicola
 
 Mexicola is a contemporary fashion and lifestyle brand inspired by tropical destinations, artisanal craftsmanship and effortless resort living. Our aesthetic combines vibrant prints, relaxed silhouettes, handcrafted details and modern bohemian luxury. We are looking for a talented Apparel Designer who can translate this distinctive vision into original, commercially relevant collections.
 


 Role Overview
 
 The Fashion Designer – Apparel will be responsible for designing and developing apparel collections for Mexicola, from initial research and concept development through sampling and production handover.
 



 The candidate should have a strong understanding of women’s resortwear, prints, fabrics, garment construction, fit and surface techniques. The role requires creativity, technical knowledge, commercial awareness and the ability to manage multiple styles and development timelines simultaneously.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesTrend Research and Concept Development
 * Research Indian and international fashion, resortwear, colour, fabric, print and silhouette trends.
* Study competitor brands, customer preferences and emerging market opportunities.
* Develop seasonal concepts, mood boards, colour palettes, print directions and collection stories.
* Translate the Chief of Design’s creative vision into cohesive and commercially viable collections.
* Maintain Mexicola’s distinctive design identity across every collection.


 Apparel Design
 * Design original apparel across categories such as dresses, kaftans, co\-ord sets, tops, shirts, skirts, trousers, jumpsuits and occasion\-resortwear.
* Create detailed hand sketches and digital fashion illustrations.
* Develop silhouettes, colourways, prints, embroideries, embellishments and placement artworks.
* Design collections that balance creativity, wearability, price positioning and commercial potential.
* Adapt designs for different seasons, occasions and customer requirements.
* Ensure that every style reflects Mexicola’s elevated, artisanal and tropical\-luxury aesthetic.


 Print and Surface Development
 * Develop original print concepts, placement artworks and seamless repeat patterns.
* Coordinate with graphic and textile designers for print development and colour separations.
* Explore embroidery, beadwork, appliqué, lace, crochet, trims and other handcrafted surface techniques.
* Prepare accurate artwork, Pantone references, print sizes and placement instructions.
* Review strike\-offs, embroidery swatches and surface\-development samples and provide corrections.


 Technical Design and Documentation
 * Prepare complete tech packs containing flat sketches, measurements, construction details, fabric information, trims and finishing requirements.
* Create specification sheets, bill of materials and design\-development sheets.
* Communicate garment\-construction details clearly to pattern makers, sampling teams and vendors.
* Maintain accurate records of styles, colourways, fabrics, artworks, approvals and revisions.
* Update range plans, line sheets and collection\-development trackers regularly.


 Fabric and Trim Development
 * Research and source suitable fabrics, linings, trims, buttons, laces and other materials.
* Work closely with the sourcing and merchandising teams to select materials that meet design, quality, cost and delivery requirements.
* Develop new fabrics, prints, washes and textures with mills and vendors where required.
* Ensure that selected fabrics are suitable for the garment’s silhouette, drape, fit and intended use.


 Sampling and Fit
 * Coordinate with pattern masters, tailors and sampling teams to develop prototypes and samples.
* Conduct regular fittings and evaluate garment fit, proportion, construction, comfort and finishing.
* Provide clear sample comments and ensure that required corrections are implemented.
* Compare samples with approved sketches, prints and specifications to maintain design accuracy.
* Follow styles through all stages, including first sample, fit sample, size set, pre\-production sample and final approval.
* Resolve design and construction issues during sampling and production.


 Collection Planning and Coordination
 * Work with the Chief of Design to create seasonal range plans and collection calendars.
* Plan an appropriate balance of categories, silhouettes, prints, colours and price points.
* Manage multiple designs and development deadlines simultaneously.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, merchandisers, sourcing teams, production teams and external vendors.
* Follow up proactively on fabrics, artworks, samples, approvals and production requirements.
* Highlight delays or quality concerns before they affect the collection launch.


 Production and Quality Support
 * Ensure that final production matches approved designs, colours, fabrics, prints and samples.
* Support the production and quality teams in resolving design\-related issues.
* Review initial production pieces and flag any deviations from the approved specifications.
* Ensure consistency in sizing, fit, finishing and overall product quality.
* Suggest design modifications when necessary without compromising the original concept.


 Shoots and Brand Presentation
 * Assist with styling and product selection for campaign, catalogue and e\-commerce shoots.
* Prepare garment details, styling references and collection notes for the content team.
* Support the development of lookbooks, line sheets, product presentations and launch materials.
* Collaborate with marketing and e\-commerce teams to communicate each collection’s design story accurately.


 Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Fashion Design, Apparel Design or a related field.
* 2–3 years of professional experience in apparel design.
* Experience in women’s contemporary fashion, resortwear, occasionwear or a design\-led fashion brand is preferred.
* Strong understanding of fabrics, garment construction, pattern making, fit and production processes.
* Experience creating detailed tech packs and coordinating with sampling teams.
* Knowledge of prints, embroidery, embellishment and surface\-development techniques.


 Technical Skills
 * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.
* Strong fashion illustration and technical flat\-sketching skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with CLO 3D, Procreate or other design software will be an advantage.
* Ability to prepare print\-ready artworks and professional presentation boards.


 Key Competencies
 * Strong creative and visual sensibility.
* Understanding of the Mexicola aesthetic and target customer.
* Excellent colour, print and silhouette sense.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of product pricing.
* Good time\-management and organisational skills.
* Ability to handle multiple styles and deadlines.
* Clear communication and effective coordination.
* Proactive, responsible and solution\-oriented approach.
* Willingness to take ownership of designs from concept to final production.


 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is passionate about fashion, travel, colour, prints and artisanal craftsmanship. They should be able to understand Mexicola’s creative direction and translate it into distinctive, wearable and commercially successful products.
 



 We are looking for someone who is both creatively strong and technically capable—an individual who can propose fresh ideas, prepare accurate design documentation, work closely with the sampling team and take responsibility for each style throughout the development process.
 


 Application Requirements
 
 Interested candidates should submit:
 


* Updated résumé
* Apparel design portfolio
* Examples of tech packs or technical drawings
* Current and expected salary
* Notice period
* Current location
